outcome: post spinal haemodynamic changes (hypotension and bradycardia)
cohort: Parturients aged 18 to 40 years with ASA physical status II undergoing elective caesarean section at term.
finding: Intravenous ondansetron administered before sub-arachnoid block in parturients undergoing caesarean section significantly reduced hypotension and variably reduced bradycardia intraoperatively.
